content: Atomic file write durability: pattern is write temp file -> fsync(temp fd) -> rename -> fsync(parent directory opened O_RDONLY). rename alone is atomic but NOT durable without directory fsync - crash can lose the directory entry (PostgreSQL ext4 thread; Ted Tso delayed-allocation zero-length-file post). Gotchas: temp file MUST be created in the same directory as the target (os.CreateTemp with target dir) or rename fails EXDEV across filesystems; macOS fsync does NOT flush drive cache - F_FULLFSYNC fcntl needed for real durability (SQLite macOS not ACID without fullfsync); ext4 default commit=5s; fsync latency 1-4ms+ on SSDs dominated by journal commit + barrier.
